<!--
Shared NEWS helpers for nemo child packages.

Included from a package's vignettes/NEWS.qmd as a knitr child chunk. In an
`#| include: false` chunk the parent sets `repo` to its GitHub URL and points
`child1` at this file via system.file("doc-templates/vignettes/_news.qmd",
package = "nemo"), then a `{r, child=child1}` chunk pulls in the helpers below.
See any child package's NEWS.qmd for the exact wiring.

The parent MUST define `repo` (the package's GitHub URL) before the child
runs; the helpers below close over it. They build links to compares, PRs,
issues, and users: pr(48), iss(11), vdiff("0.1.0", "0.0.3"), user("reisingerf").
-->

```{r}
#| label: news-pkgs
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

{
  use("htmltools", "a")
  use("glue", "glue")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: news-funcs
#| echo: false

stopifnot(exists("repo"), is.character(repo), nzchar(repo))

vdiff <- function(new, old) {
  stopifnot(utils::compareVersion(new, old) == 1)
  htmltools::a(
    href = glue::glue("{repo}/compare/v{old}...v{new}"),
    glue::glue("v{new} - v{old} diff")
  )
}

pr_or_issue <- function(n, type) {
  x <- c(iss = "issues", pr = "pull")
  stopifnot(is.numeric(n), n > 0, type %in% names(x))
  type2 <- x[type]
  htmltools::a(
    href = glue::glue("{repo}/{type2}/{n}"),
    glue::glue("{type}{n}")
  )
}

iss <- function(n) {
  pr_or_issue(n, "iss")
}

pr <- function(n) {
  pr_or_issue(n, "pr")
}

user <- function(x) {
  htmltools::a(
    href = glue::glue("https://github.com/{x}"),
    glue::glue("@{x}")
  )
}
```
